summary: Completed comprehensive backend testing of Unified Ticket Booking Flow. All 30 pytest tests passed (100%). The unified ticket APIs using issued_tickets as single source of truth are working correctly. Tested: ticket issuance, lookup with pagination/filtering, check-in with unique_code and qr_payload, undo check-in, cancel ticket, update ticket, and statistics.
seed_data_creation: Test tickets created with TEST_ prefix and cleaned up after tests
context_for_next_testing_agent: Unified Ticket Booking Flow fully tested. All APIs working correctly with issued_tickets as single source of truth. Test file at /app/backend/tests/test_unified_ticket_booking.py covers all endpoints.

POST_issued_tickets_issue.details: Issues ticket with all fields, generates unique_code (6 chars), qr_payload, ticket_number. Status set to 'valid' for completed payments.

GET_issued_tickets.details: Returns paginated list with filtering by status, checked_in, and search. Includes event_name, ticket_type_name, booking_code joins.

GET_issued_tickets_stats.details: Returns total_issued, total_checked_in, total_pending, total_valid, total_cancelled, total_expired, total_revenue

GET_issued_tickets_by_id.details: Returns single ticket by ID, 404 for not found

POST_checkin_unique_code.details: Check-in with unique_code works, sets is_checked_in=true, status='used', checked_in_at, checked_in_by

POST_checkin_qr_payload.details: Check-in with qr_payload works identically to unique_code

POST_checkin_cancelled_ticket.details: Returns 400 with message about cancelled status

POST_cancel_ticket.details: Sets status='cancelled', appends reason to notes

PUT_update_ticket.details: Updates holder_name, holder_email, holder_phone, notes. Changes persist.

test_classes: TestUnifiedTicketIssue (4 tests) - Ticket issuance with various inputs
TestUnifiedTicketLookup (8 tests) - Ticket retrieval with pagination/filtering
TestUnifiedTicketCheckIn (5 tests) - Check-in with unique_code and qr_payload
TestUnifiedTicketUpdate (3 tests) - Ticket update and persistence
TestUnifiedTicketEdgeCases (3 tests) - Error handling and edge cases
